title: fix(status): correct stale context limits after model discovery
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Local model discovery, refresh, or a model/runtime switch can leave status and session reports showing an older context limit, another runtime's limit, or a generic denominator.

## User Impact

Reports use the selected model/runtime's admitted capacity, configured caps, or a matching verified run budget. Unknown capacity stays `?` (`null` in session-list JSON), without an invented percentage. Spawned workspaces retain their own catalog/budget scope. Execution and compaction budgeting are preserved.

## Why This Change Was Made

This preserves @snotty's original reporting repair and consumes the existing model catalog and context-provenance owners. CLI sessions passively reads the inspected local Gateway's prepared catalog; explicit-store and other-workspace rows use scoped saved facts. Failed Gateway reads warn once and retain the offline path. Runtime choices remain tagged so one runtime cannot supply another's capacity.

The branch is independent of Copilot #156636 and retains work already landed in #159731 and #168309. Main `61722c8ecbd27cdb960e7a6f9055f17ad3ae8a04` was merged without rebasing or rewriting contributor history, including @snotty's latest regression commit `fbfa840f2b49`. The conflict resolution keeps main's configured/fixed-context consolidation and its intentional retirement of redundant status tests. The contributor's captured-cache tests remain.

## Evidence

Prior live proof used isolated state and real OpenClaw CLI/Gateway entry points on main `c6d71fae0ed1` and repaired head `3366edb5ae30`:

- Ollama `qwen3:8b` answered a real turn. After selecting discovered `qwen3:4b`, main CLI sessions reported **200000**; repaired CLI reported **32768 before another turn**, and the next Qwen turn admitted 32768.
- A task-owned llama-server answered at **16384**, then restarted at **32768**. After `models.list` refresh, main CLI sessions remained 16384; repaired CLI/Gateway rows and `/context json` reported 32768, and another real turn completed. Main `/status` already handled this known-capacity refresh correctly.
- After removing a task-owned Ollama alias and refreshing discovery, main `/status` reported `?/200k` and CLI 200000. Repaired `/status` reported `?/?` and CLI `null`. The repaired head also completed another real Qwen3:4b turn at 32768.

Main-failing status regressions establish stale-cache and other-runtime errors. A spawned-workspace CLI regression failed before its repair when the parent catalog's 131072 replaced a matching saved 16384 budget; the repaired path preserves workspace ownership.

Main-merged head `01083e250da949544106f0bfebcc520de5c6e185` passes **213 focused tests**: nine primary files / 180 cases in **795.55s wall**, context/status adapters / 31 cases in **293.68s**, and Gateway health scheduling / 2 cases in **224.94s**, all with one worker. Cold worker preparation dominates these busy-host wall times; no sleeps, retries or worker pins were added. Core types, all 28 consuming test-type graphs, touched lint/formatting, assertion safety, max-lines, line-cap, timeout-race, mock-export, config-doc and plugin-inventory checks pass. Gateway worktree preparation/build passes. Fresh Codex autoreview is **scoped-clean through P2**. The reporting change introduces no prompt text/token delta.

Incoming main directly repairs the earlier Bun observer failure in `952c102dde987`: invalidate exact row facts after installing the reader observer, while retaining bounded-key, sibling, SQL and reuse assertions. Correction to the previous diagnosis: the recovery case's expected-zero failure was the shared Gateway-work drain assertion, not a membership authorization assertion. The exact-head [CI run 38164531708](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38164531708) passed all 62 executed jobs, including `openclaw/ci-gate`. [Blacksmith Testbox](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38163543012) verified that source/tree and passed the original nine-file Linux Bun group **101/101 in 86.01s wall**, including the observer and both recovery cases. The initial Testbox attempt lacked Bun; its prerequisite was repaired using the repository's checksum-pinned installer, and the successful lease was stopped. No remaining red CI job required a main-base comparison.

ClawSweeper's accepted P2 is fixed in final candidate `1cf9a6c53b953987f503d81814b378c0d4f66337`: corrupt, unreadable or unverifiable optional Gateway locks now warn once and fall back to saved/configured capacity without contacting an unverified owner. The CLI boundary regression failed before repair and all **24 session cases passed in 186.23s wall** afterward. The real command entry point protects the inspection/transport/offline boundary that smaller resolver tests cannot cover. Core/command-test types, lint, formatting and required ratchets pass again; final-head Codex autoreview is **scoped-clean through P2**. The Gateway/storage paths from the Linux proof are unchanged. Final-head [CI run 38167012438](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38167012438) passed all **62 executed jobs**, including `openclaw/ci-gate` (25 skipped). ClawSweeper reviewed exact head `1cf9a6c53b95` and lists **no code findings**; its remaining requests are proof-only and covered by the campaign lead’s explicit override. No inherited-CI exception is needed.

Telegram, live spawned-workspace, and real-CLI unverifiable-lock captures remain outside the maintainer-directed proof scope; the campaign lead overrides these proof-only holds. No code finding is waived.

The current diff versus merged main is production **+456/-226**, tests/support **+515/-84**, docs **+13/-1**, and one obsolete mock-baseline entry removed. The net 230 production lines implement passive catalog transport and explicit owner/runtime binding; superseded fallbacks were removed without adding a second capacity owner. No configuration, schema, dependency or protocol change is introduced by this repair.
